text:
Type: window pane wall mirror
Use: reflecting light, decorating a wall; living room, bedroom, entryway, above a console or dresser
Style: industrial, farmhouse, rustic
Materials: metal frame with distressed antique finish, mirror glass
Colors: antique grey, muted blue-grey
Shape: tall rectangle with rounded corners, cross mullions dividing four panes like an old window, slim frame, medium size, light visual weight
Feel: vintage, relaxed, airy
Goes with: weathered wood, white or grey walls, black iron accents; farmhouse or industrial rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Vintage Window Mirror -28 Inch, Antique Grey Blue
product.description: Complete your room with this beautifully simple antique-blue/grey mirror. Arriving ready to hang, this mirror has a durable iron frame and a distressed finish that creates a vintage look. Its modern take on the classic antique-mirror design makes this mirror perfect for transitional-style home décor. 28.15"H x 18.3"W x 0.98"D Mirror glass with an iron frame This casual mirror's antique styling blends well with both modern and vintage home-décor styles. No hanging materials needed
